metadata.overview: Reports Luxor Bitcoin pool hashrate, active workers, balance and 24-hour mining revenue over the read-only Luxor Pool API v2.

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Five-minute pool-side hashrate across the configured subaccounts or site.

telemetry.name: workers_online
telemetry.description: Active miners across the configured subaccounts or site.

telemetry.name: balance
telemetry.description: Unpaid BTC balance across the configured subaccounts or site.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Mining revenue over the last 24 hours, used as the estimate for today.

telemetry.name: health
telemetry.description: { status: 'OK' } when the Luxor API answers for the configured scope, otherwise { status: 'OFFLINE', error } with a stable error code. Never includes the API key.

troubleshooting: If alert.pool_unreachable, verify apiUrl, apiKey, the subaccount names or site ID, and outbound HTTPS connectivity.
If alert.hashrate_low, cross-check the fleet's own hashrate before escalating.

errors.E_POOL_API: Pool REST API request failed, or no fresh poll yet
errors.ERR_LUXOR_AUTH: The API key is wrong or revoked
errors.ERR_LUXOR_API: A Luxor API request failed; the message carries the path and HTTP status
errors.ERR_LUXOR_DATA: A Luxor API response field is missing or malformed
